content: आरोहः [आ-रुह्-घञ्] .²1 One who mounts, a rider, as in अश्वारोह, स्यन्दनारोह; सारोहाणां च वाजिनाम् <ls>Rām.</ls>; one who is seated in a carriage. .²2 Ascent, rising, mounting, ascending, riding; आरोहे विनये चैव युक्तो वारणवाजिनाम् <ls>Rām. 2. 1. 28</ls>. .²3 An elevated place, elevation, altitude; height; नगाद्यारोह; उच्छ्रायः <ls>Ak.</ls>; <ls>Mb. 13. 147. 16</ls>. .²4 Haughtiness, pride. .²5 A mountain, a heap. .²6 A womanʼs waist; the buttocks; सा रामा न वरारोहा <ls>Udb.</ls>; आरोहैर्निबिडबृहन्नितम्बबिम्बैः <ls>Śi. 8. 8</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 10. 6. 16</ls>. .²7 Length. .²8 A kind of measure. .²9 A mine. .²10 Descending.
